findings.claim: The headless bootstrap wrapper never performs the additionalDirectories reconcile that /smine-orchestrate bootstrap delegates to 'the invoking wrapper', so the bootstrap run's required reconcile duty (spec-5 C12/C18: orchestrate bootstrap 'commits directly, syncs, reconciles') is absent. smine-orchestrate SKILL.md §5 states the invoking wrapper appends registry paths before the stage and the skill must never write ~/.claude/settings.json itself (headless sensitive-file guard); routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:302-308 does that append before its stage 3, but cmd/bootstrap/run.sh goes straight from the apply stage to run_stage smine-orchestrate (line 161) with no jq merge of repos.json paths. Sequence: casual install with a repos.json project R whose path is not in permissions.additionalDirectories (a registration made before the forced casual grant, or after a re-run of install.sh/sync_settings reset the list) -> Welcome Bootstrap -> orchestrate §5 finds R missing, can only report it, R stays out of the settings roster, so the --repos roster built from additionalDirectories keeps omitting R and its sessions are not attributed to R's folder.
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/bootstrap/run.sh in full at 1f725ce: lines 77-85 only READ additionalDirectories to build --repos; lines 154-161 run the five stages; no write to $settings_file anywhere in the file. Re-read routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:297-308 (wrapper-owned append-only merge of repos.json paths, comment 'headless agents cannot write ~/.claude/settings.json ... the wrapper owns this mechanical append ... (C12 revised)'). git grep of skills/smine/smine-orchestrate/SKILL.md at 1f725ce: line 31 'additionalDirectories is wrapper-owned: this skill verifies and reports, never writes the user settings file directly'; line 61 'The invoking wrapper appends registry paths to permissions.additionalDirectories before this stage'; line 3 names '/smine-orchestrate bootstrap as the bootstrap wrapper's terminal stage'. spec-5 C18 requires bootstrap mode to 'sync, reconcile'; spec-9 (headless bootstrap) moved bootstrap into this wrapper without carrying the append. Interplay note: the known open finding that orchestrate's sync_settings.sh overwrites additionalDirectories (routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:302 row) also affects this path; this claim is the distinct missing-duty in the bootstrap wrapper and stands after that fix.
findings.fix: In cmd/bootstrap/run.sh, before run_stage smine-orchestrate (and outside dry-run), add the same append-only merge routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:302-308 performs: when repos.json and a non-empty $settings_file exist (gated to the casual audience per C12), jq-append every $registry[0].repos[].path missing from .permissions.additionalDirectories, write via tmp + mv.
